title: Cohomology characters on the incidence correspondence
summary: We investigate the cohomology of line bundles on the incidence correspondence, the partial flag variety parametrizing pairs consisting of a point in projective space and a hyperplane containing it. In characteristic zero, this cohomology is governed by the Borel-Weil-Bott theorem. In characteristic p>0, however, it becomes considerably subtler, and admits an equivalent reformulation in terms of cohomology tables for divided powers of the cotangent bundle on projective space.
